@Gideon Sato, from the #inc-vtg-hartford history on 3 Aug:

- **First report:** your message at **10:42 AM**: gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant, both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.
- **Guard in the meantime:** the only note on the guard is in that same 10:42 message: "Guard is writing trailer numbers on a clipboard."
- **Afterward:** Mateo reported six trucks waiting at the east gate at 10:44. Kiosk 1 was back at 11:03, when the guard checked in trailer 8836. You posted at 11:08 that both lanes were working as of 11:07.

The times are as shown in the channel. I didn't confirm which time zone they're in, so check that before you put them in the postmortem.
